fab_stackup.name: 4-layers PCB 0.8MM, outer 1OZ, inner 1OZ, residual copper ratio 70%

source.document: Multi-layer laminated structure, "PCB standard stackup" table, 4 Layers (the page lists 298 stackups; filter data attributes Layers, Thickness, Inner Copper, Outer Copper, Inner layer Residual copper ratio)
source.notes: Rows are the page's own HTML table for the stackup, read once (the page serves every stackup in one document; no login, generic client name). Only 4-layer stackups the page labels "Regular", 1OZ finished outer copper, 1OZ inner copper, at 0.8, 1.0, 1.2 and 1.6 MM are written; the page lists 112 four-layer stackups in all (other thicknesses, 1.5OZ and 2OZ inner copper, 2OZ outer copper, and rows with no label are not written). PCBWay gives these stackups no names: the name here is built from the page's own labels. The page's "Thickness (mm)" column is before lamination and "Thickness after lamination(mm)" after; both are kept as the page gives them. Outer copper is the page's "Outer Base Copper 0.5OZ" (0.0175 mm) "Plating to 1OZ"; the page states no plated thickness. The page says: "This is a through-hole board stack-up, not applicable for blind and buried vias." Re-read before ordering: PCBWay changes these tables.

nominal.basis: The page's "Thickness:" label and filter value (data-BoardThickness), 1.6MM for example

fab_stackup.layers_sum_basis: Every row's "Thickness (mm)" (before lamination; outer copper is the 0.5OZ base foil) added, with the inner foils: the core row lists the core without them.
fab_stackup.layers_sum_after_lamination_basis: The outer base foils and each prepreg's "Thickness after lamination" plus the "Core with Cu" cell (the core and its two inner foils), as the page lists them.
disagreements: PCBWay's older table (blog post "The newest version of PCBWay Multi-layer laminated structure", https://www.pcbway.com/blog/Engineering_Technical/stackup___pcbway.html, which marks it "Old version 2019" and points to the page used here), "0.8mm±0.1mm1oz": Dielectric 1-2 0.175 mm dielectric constant 4.29; Dielectric 2-3 0.33 mm dielectric constant 3.96; Dielectric 3-4 0.175 mm dielectric constant 4.29. The newer page is used.

PCBWay lists 7628 prepreg Dk 4.74 and core Dk 4.6; JLCPCB lists 7628 4.4 and each core 3.99 to 4.56 (library/stackups/jlcpcb). Different fabricators, different laminate: not a conflict, but the values are not interchangeable.
